profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Google | ex-Meta
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
- Built Facebook Business Extension (FBE)  to connect 1M local businesses with Facebook and Instagram, touching $1B+ revenue annually
- Developed Facebook App Store hosting 20+ apps to help businesses easily connect with Facebook and Instagram
- Led a global team of 10 Solutions Engineers to further partner acquisition and improve overall onboarding process
- Consulted top Enterprise partners (e.g, BigCommerce, GoDaddy, Square, etc.) on Facebook/Instagram integrations on their E-commerce platforms to drive sales and marketing efforts

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
- Built brand new UI toolkit for PartnerCentral for UI redesign across the site in project group
- Improve overall code quality & consistency with adoption of Less, Sass, and ESLint across PartnerCentral repositories
- Led technical guidance and development on RTL support across PartnerCentral teams
- Reduced TTI to 3 seconds (TP95) worldwide for PartnerCentral
- Collaborated with XFN teams for traffic management, CDN configuration, and Salesforce integration
- Implement CI pipeline and test automations using Jenkins, Docker, AWS ECS

positions.title: Management Audit IT Intern, Management Audit
positions.description:
- Performed IT/Finance Sample Testing (User/Control Testing) and Code Reviews, along with security and legal compliance review for applications across company.
- Led creation/maintenance of automation tools and departmental projects.
- Participated in IT/Integrated Internal Audit process: planning, fieldwork, wrap up & reporting, and archiving
- Participated in Annual Planning, performing business analysis and risk management, drafting deliverable for communication of Annual Planning with the business units and executives

positions.title: IT Intern, Technology Infrastructure & Operations
positions.description:
- Created test suites of regression tests for web forms and software for deployment
- Built Selenium-based test automaton program for company website
- Participated in regular program integration and updates on systems and software
- Generated a website (HTML5/CSS) for Oakwood Disaster Recovery program and update preexisting websites with new code

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant, Viterbi School of Engineering
positions.description:
- Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for CSCI 103 – Introduction to Programming, an introductory C/C++ class for CSCI majors and minors
- Directed and mentored students in labs and projects assigned throughout the semester
- Proctored students during exams and team projects

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.description: Any undergraduate student who earns a grade point average of 3.5 or higher on 12 or more units of letter-graded course work in any one semester is placed on the Dean's List for that semester. All students on the Dean's List receive a certificate from the Viterbi School of Engineering.
honors.issuer: Issued by USC Viterbi School of Engineering · May 2016

honors.title: New Star Scholarship
honors.description: New Star Scholarship is a scholarship provided to any current undergraduate student who demonstrates a need for financial assistance as well as academic excellence. New Star Scholarship has been ongoing for fifteen years, and continues to provide for Korean American immigrant student community.

organizations.name: KOJOBS USC (Korean Job Search Clubs)
organizations.position: Finance & Administrative Team Manager · Aug 2013 - May 2015
organizations.description: KOJOBS named as Korean Job Search is found in 2012. KOJOBS has been dedicated to be leading "Job searching" and Gloabal Networking for Korean Students all around the world. Our project is focused on the offering job informations and events for preparing students for a career in business successfuly. So far, KOJOBS Club has united with UCLA, USC, UCB, UCSD, UCI, UCD, UW, and HFUS, and we have +500 board members. We also have partnership with Korean Student Association of Canada.

organizations.name: Korean-American Scientist and Engineer Association (KSEA)
organizations.description: KSEA was established in 1971 as a non-profit professional organization and has grown to over 6,000 registered members with 70 local chapters (including four Branches) and 13 technical groups across the United States. The organization objectives are to: Promote the application of science and technology for the general welfare of society, Foster international cooperation especially between the U.S. and Korea, and Help Korean-American Scientists and Engineers develop their full career potential.
